avg.description: The average frequency (in ms) for data updates

max.description: The maximum expected frequency (in ms) for data updates

min.description: The minimum expected frequency (in ms) for data updates

description:
Dear Team,

Our latest performance metrics show that the data feed updates on average every 1 500 ms. The shortest observed interval between updates is 500 ms, while the longest interval can extend up to 3 000 ms. These figures will help us fine‑tune our processing pipelines and set appropriate timeout thresholds.
